document.abstract:
This document specifies a new IMF Application as a specialization of the IMF Framework to no-proxy workflow using the hierarchical properties of VC-6 to create workflow efficiencies through layered storage and transport whilst retaining the auditing and versioning capabilities of IMF. 
The new IMF Application targets UHDTV and larger images that are encoded using SMPTE ST 2117-1 with multiple echelons and bitrates that deliver visually lossless and mathematically lossless storage.
